SOC_BMS.notes: BMS state of charge (raw, not display-adjusted) Ranges between 5-95%

BATTERY_POWER.notes: Computed from voltage * current. Negative = charging.

BMS_MAIN_RELAY.notes: BMS main (HV) relay closed. 2026-07-20: set (1) in all responsive captures — READY, AC & DC charging.

AC_CHARGER_CONNECTED.notes: AC / EVSE-PLUG PRESENCE ONLY - narrowed 2026-08-08 from two complementary observations. (1) DC: b5 stays 0 through the entire 16:31:47-16:44:28 CCS fast charge (n=50, distinct=1) even at -173 A / 64 kW with the connector physically latched, so it is not a general 'a charger is connected' flag. (2) AC cable, no energy: 17:53-18:30 the car sat on a home EVSE that only supplies power on a schedule; b5=1 while CHARGING (b7)=0 and BMS_MAIN_RELAY (b0)=0 (n=31, byte 0x20), with OBC_PILOT_DUTY 100% (pilot high, no PWM current offer) and contactors open. So b5 tracks AC cable/pilot PRESENCE, not energy flow - it is set whether or not the EVSE is delivering. Do not use it to detect charging of either kind: use CHARGING (b7) for AC energy flow and CHARGING_DC (b6) for DC. Set in 0x20 (AC plugged, contactors open) and 0xA3 (AC charging). Backs the PLUGGED state predicate.

CHARGING_DC.notes: CONFIRMED 2026-08-08 on this vehicle - previously community lineage only, never observed set. During the 16:31-16:43 50 kW DC fast charge (sustained -172 A, SOC 39->77%) b6 reads 1; across 1576 pre-2026-08-08 AC-charging captures b6 reads 0 in every single one while b7 (CHARGING) reads 1. So b6 is set ONLY on DC charging and is genuinely distinct from b7, not a duplicate of it. New byte value 0xC3 = b0+b1+b6+b7 = DC charging, versus 0xA3 = b0+b1+b5+b7 = AC charging. Note b5 (CHARGER_CONNECTED) stays CLEAR on CCS.

CUMULATIVE_ENERGY_CHARGED.notes: Lifetime cumulative. ECU reports in 0.1 kWh units, /10 gives kWh. Verified ~12274 kWh lifetime on 2017 Ioniq 28kWh.

CUMULATIVE_ENERGY_DISCHARGED.notes: Lifetime cumulative. ECU reports in 0.1 kWh units, /10 gives kWh.

CUMULATIVE_CURRENT_CHARGED.notes: 32-bit at ISO-TP 0x20 = WiCAN B38,B39,B41,B42 (skips PCI byte B40). 2026-07-20 fix: the old ((B32<<24)|...) conflated ImHex/ISO-TP offset 0x20 with WiCAN B32 — but B32 is a PCI frame byte, giving ~61,700,000 Ah of garbage. Corrected bytes read ~34,000 Ah, consistent with CUMULATIVE_ENERGY_CHARGED (÷ pack voltage ≈ same Ah). Sits just before the energy u32s.

CUMULATIVE_CURRENT_DISCHARGED.notes: 32-bit at ISO-TP 0x24 = WiCAN B43,B44,B45,B46. 2026-07-20 fix: old ((B36<<24)|...) used the wrong (PCI-unaware) indices, giving ~917,000 Ah. Corrected reads ~34,000 Ah, consistent with CUMULATIVE_ENERGY_DISCHARGED.

OPERATING_TIME.notes: 32-bit unsigned, ISO-TP bytes 48-51 (WiCAN B57-B60). Raw value is seconds, /3600 converts to hours. Live-verified 2026-04-14: 5902h. Was B57 (single byte = MSB of u32, always 0x01 = 1).

DRIVE_MOTOR_SPEED.notes: CORRECTED 2026-08-08. Was expression B65, which read only the HIGH byte as UNSIGNED: it saturated 0-255 and scored just r=+0.391 vs real motor RPM. Correct field is signed 16-bit BIG-endian at WiCAN B65:B66 (payload idx 55:56, same ISO-TP frame as B65 so no PCI crossing; BE matches the rest of the BMS 2101 payload convention). Verified r=+0.997 vs MCU:2102:MCU_MOTOR_RPM on n=1149 MEASURED rows (--fill none, no forward-fill), fit slope 0.986 so the raw value is RPM directly; observed -200..7400 RPM vs the reference's -208..7649 including negative regen. Null test: median 0 through the 16:31-16:43 50 kW DCFC, the single 500 RPM sample being the coast-down at the drive/park boundary. Note B67 duplicates B65, so a mirrored or filtered copy of this signal likely follows at B67:B68.

CELL_01_VOLTAGE.notes: First cell. 2026-07-20 FIX: cells start at B9 (after the 4-byte 0xFFFFFFFF cell-present header at B4-B7) and skip PCI bytes (B8/16/24/32/40). The old linear B(5+n) mapping was wrong on two counts: CELL_01/02 read the 0xFF header (5.10V) and CELL_03/11/19/27 landed on PCI bytes (0.66-0.72V). Correct WiCAN indices per in-PID cell (1..32): B9,10,11,12,13,14,15, B17,18,19,20,21,22,23, B25,26,27,28,29,30,31, B33,34,35,36,37,38,39, B41,42,43,44. Same layout for 2103 (33-64) and 2104 (65-96).

CELL_33_VOLTAGE.notes: First cell in PID 2103. Same B6..B37 pattern as 2102.

CELL_65_VOLTAGE.notes: First cell in PID 2104. Same B6..B37 pattern.

CELL_96_VOLTAGE.notes: Last cell. Total: 96 cells across PIDs 2102/2103/2104.

CCM.description: Charge Control Module (Power Line Communication for DC CCS fast-charging)

EPB.description: EPB (Electronic Parking Brake) — chassis/brake module adjacent to ESC/EPS

EPS_VEHICLE_SPEED.notes: EPS-side vehicle speed echo (speed-dependent steering assist). ISO-TP 0x0B. Tracks ESC REAL_SPEED_KMH within +-1 km/h across 0-39 km/h drive; 0 at standstill. UNSIGNED magnitude — reads positive when reversing (like ESC REAL_SPEED_KMH); single byte, no sign. EPS carries no gear/direction, so a directional speed can't be derived from this PID alone — use ESC GEAR_SELECTOR for direction.

EPS_STEERING_ANGLE.notes: Absolute steering wheel angle. Signed big-endian 16-bit: S9=sign/high byte (ISO-TP 0x06, WiCAN B09), B10=low byte (0x07/B10); angle=-(S9*256+B10)/10 deg to match ESC SAS sign. r=+1.000 (n=29, resid 1.35deg) vs verified ESC 22C101 STEERING_ANGLE over the 2026-07-30 +-90deg steer sweep. Supersedes the disproven B10:B11 LE 'EPS_STEERING_FAST' (B10 is this angle's low byte) and the old EPS_B9_FLAG (=this sign byte). Full-lock (>90deg) not swept this session but the signed-16 range covers it.

REAL_SPEED_KMH.notes: ESC vehicle-speed estimate, 1 km/h/bit at ISO-TP 0x09. Verified against 4 wheel speeds (B18-B21, r=+1.000) and driving profile 0-39 km/h. Reads 0 at standstill. UNSIGNED magnitude — reads POSITIVE when reversing (2026-07-26: gear=Reverse segments show +1..2 km/h). This is correct wheel-speed-sensor behaviour, NOT a decode bug: there is no sign and no high byte — the neighbours B10/B11/B13 are constant 0xFF padding (distinct=1). Direction of travel is carried separately by GEAR_SELECTOR (B14). A signed/directional speed must be derived downstream (magnitude x gear-direction); it can't be expressed as single-frame WiCAN arithmetic (no conditional, and the gear enum->sign isn't clean arithmetic).

WHEEL_SPEED_FL.notes: Individual wheel speed, 1 km/h/bit. ISO-TP 0x0E. Left/right grouping confirmed (B18/B20 track together = left pair, diverge with B19/B21 in turns). Front/rear within side by Ioniq5/OBDb FL,FR,RL,RR convention — not independently verified.

WHEEL_SPEED_FR.notes: Individual wheel speed, 1 km/h/bit. ISO-TP 0x0F. Right pair (B19/B21 track together). Front/rear by convention.

WHEEL_SPEED_RL.notes: Individual wheel speed, 1 km/h/bit. ISO-TP 0x10. Left pair (B18/B20 track together). Front/rear by convention.

WHEEL_SPEED_RR.notes: Individual wheel speed, 1 km/h/bit. ISO-TP 0x11. Right pair (B19/B21 track together). Front/rear by convention.

GEAR_SELECTOR.notes: Transmission range / shifter position echoed on the ESC/ABS module. B14 (ISO-TP data). Sequential PRND encoding 1=Park, 2=Reverse, 4=Drive (3=Neutral assumed, still unobserved). r=-1.000 vs VCU:2101:GEAR_P over the 2026-07-22 drive (fit park->1, drive->4). VERIFIED 2026-07-26 driveway back-and-forth: value 2 tracked the reverse segments exactly (n=52 while backing up at 17:00:20-43 and 17:01:06-17:03:03), value 4 the forward pulls, 1 at rest — real-driving confirmation of R=2/D=4/P=1. NOTE: this is the direction source for vehicle speed (REAL_SPEED_KMH/wheel speeds are unsigned magnitudes). Neutral (expected 3) still needs a capture: 2026-08-06 found that VCU:2101:GEAR_N DID catch Neutral (n=3, 2026-07-19 17:42), but ESC 22C101 was not co-polled that day, so value 3 remains unconfirmed — one co-polled shift through N closes it.

STEERING_ANGLE.notes: Absolute steering wheel angle sensor (SAS) echoed on ESC/ABS. Big-endian offset-binary 16-bit at ISO-TP 0x1D:0x1E (WiCAN B35:B36, both in CAN frame 4 — no PCI between), zero at 0x8000, scale /10 deg. VERIFIED 2026-07-30: over the DRIVING steer-sweep it tracks EPS 220101 EPS_STEERING_ANGLE r=+1.000, both crossing ~0 at centre together (independent ECUs, same SAS) and matching magnitudes across +-90deg; scale and 0x8000 zero confirmed. Holds large non-zero values while stationary => angle, not yaw rate. The 2026-07-26 '+24deg at rest' was the wheel parked slightly off-centre, not a zero offset. NOTE: rare ECU init/invalid frames read ~3276deg (raw ~0xFFFx) — filter as out-of-range. Distinct from EPS B12:B13 (fast rate/torque).

HVAC_INTERIOR_TEMP.notes: Interior Air Temperature (not "intake"!). Confirmed: drops from 27°C to 18.5°C when AC blows cold air, slowly recovers. Tracks cabin temp well.

HVAC_AAT.notes: Ambient Air Temperature (HVAC sensor). Stable at ~18.5°C during session.

HVAC_HEAT_PUMP_TEMP.notes: Refrigerant-circuit temperature. Verified by behaviour: 21.5C at rest, drops to ~5C with the compressor running, recovers when it cycles off (clear thermal lag vs interior temp). Exact sensor unconfirmed (evaporator / heat-pump inlet-outlet / heat-exchanger) — the HEAT_PUMP name is a best guess.

HVAC_COMPRESSOR_ON.notes: Binary compressor on/off STATUS flag (0/1) — a status byte, not a physical relay (renamed from HVAC_COMPRESSOR_RELAY 2026-07-22). distinct=2 across 196 captures (=1 ~21%). Verified live 2026-07-22: reads 1 while the e-compressor runs (heat-pump heating, ~1.5kW HV draw) and 0 during PTC-only heating and idle. Cleaner than the 220100 FF-junk HVAC_AC_COMPRESSOR_ON. (Nuance: should also read 1 during A/C cooling — untested today; if it's actually heat-pump-mode-only, cooling would show 0.)

HVAC_SET_TEMP_DRIVER.notes: Set temperature (driver side). Direct °C value: 0x14=20°C, 0x1E=30°C, 0x0F=15°C — all match user input exactly.

HVAC_SET_TEMP_PASSENGER.notes: Set temperature (passenger side or redundancy). Always matches B44 in single-zone Ioniq. Dual-zone mirror.

HVAC_ON_FLAG.notes: HVAC system running flag. 1 when HVAC is on, 0 when off.

HVAC_BLOWER_FAN_SPEED.notes: Actual blower fan speed indicator (analog feedback, not rigid setpoint). Verified by a deliberate fan 1->MAX->1 sweep (2026-07-26 heater-high session): 8 clean symmetric monotonic plateaus L1=40 L2=52 L3=65 L4=77 L5=90 L6=102 L7=111 L8/MAX=121 (~+12/level, compresses at top). Fan-only session steps matched (52/65/90 on 3->5). Enum labels the plateau centers; small off-plateau values (35-93) are transients when vents/recirc change airflow load and fall through to the raw number.

CHARGE_PORT_LOCK_INV.notes: 0=locked, 1=unlocked. Verified 2026-07-18. Safety feedback of charge port lock?

DRL.notes: Daytime Running Lights. Bit flag — 1=on. On in all light modes (DRL, low beam, high beam). Verified 2026-04-15.

TAIL_LIGHTS.notes: Tail/position lights. Bit flag — 1=on. On in all light modes (DRL, low beam, high beam). Verified 2026-04-15.

HIGH_BEAM.notes: Bit flag — 1=on. Only set with high beams active. Niro PR had this on BC04 B13:4 — wrong for Ioniq. Verified 2026-04-15.

LOW_BEAM.notes: Low beam headlights. Bit flag — 1=on. Also set when high beams are on (both low+high active together). Verified 2026-04-15.

ACC2_IGN_ON.notes: Renamed from IGNITION_ON — misleading because the ignition is NOT physically on. Activates at ACC2/IGN1 power state. Cannot distinguish ACC2 from Ready — both show bit=1. OFF and ACC1 both show bit=0. Fob-unlock does NOT set this bit (confirmed 2026-04-18 — B11 stays 0x00 on fob unlock, the 0x2C seen was B12 lights). Also reads 1 during ACC2+AC charging (2026-04-19). Verified 2026-04-15.

IGPM_CONFIG_BYTE.notes: Static configuration/capability byte (IGPM BC03 WiCAN B09). Always 0x73 (01110011) across all tested states: deep sleep, ACC, ready, locked, unlocked, key in, key out (16 captures 2026-04-14 to 2026-04-18). Originally misidentified as "POWER_MODE" — the changing byte was actually B10 (door lock bits). Likely a hardware revision or feature flag. Verified static 2026-04-18.

DOOR_LOCK_RL.notes: 1=locked, 0=unlocked. Niro PR used inverted 1-B10:1 but Ioniq raw bit already has correct polarity. Verified 2026-04-15.

DOOR_LOCK_RR.notes: 1=locked, 0=unlocked. Niro PR used inverted 1-B10:3 but Ioniq raw bit already has correct polarity. Verified 2026-04-15.

BRAKE_LIGHT.notes: Brake-pressed state code, NOT a boolean despite the name. Across 290 captures B10 reads 0x00 off (n=267) and 0x2D pressed (n=23), plus one-off 0x01 and 0x02 — previously misattributed as turn-signal bits, but the real turn signal was found on B11 2026-08-09, so these are unrelated noise. 0x2D sets bits 0,2,3,5 together, so the brake press drives four bits at once — bit2 is the cleanest brake candidate (BRAKE_PEDAL_BITS); bits 3 and 5 are undecoded and never move independently of it, so they are co-driven rather than separate signals. Position verified 2026-04-15 (Ioniq 5 OBDb had this at B4, wrong for the 2017). Deliberately left as a raw byte with no type: enum, so coverage --bitfields keeps reporting the undecoded bits 3 and 5.

LEFT_TURN_SIGNAL.notes: Left turn signal stalk, bit0 of B11. 500-sample dump-bytes check: B11=0 n=423, 1 n=35 (left), 2 n=42 (right), never 3 (no hazard co-activation observed). Supersedes the disabled B10:0 param, which was disproven 2026-08-06 as an artifact of the brake pattern (0x2D).

RIGHT_TURN_SIGNAL.notes: Right turn signal stalk, bit1 of B11. 500-sample dump-bytes check: B11=0 n=423, 1 n=35 (left), 2 n=42 (right), never 3 (no hazard co-activation observed). Supersedes the downgraded B10:1 param, which had only n=1 support on the wrong byte.

MCU_HV_VOLTAGE.notes: HV DC-link voltage at the motor inverter, coarse 8-bit (~2.56 V/LSB). VERIFIED 2026-08-05 against the verified BMS BATTERY_VOLTAGE over a 3h AC charge whose SOC-driven pack-voltage sweep (360-399 V) gave a wide anchor: B13*2.56 tracks BMS pack voltage 1:1 — slope 0.991, r=0.981, residual 2.30 V (=1 LSB), mean offset -1.4 V, across 2016 co-timed CHARGING samples. Confirms both the byte (B13) and the 2.56 scale. The pack voltage is also carried fine-resolution on BMS BATTERY_VOLTAGE and the verified VCU INVERTER_INPUT_VOLTAGE (B17*2); this is the MCU-side coarse copy, useful as an integrity cross-check.

MCU_MOTOR_RPM.notes: Signed 16-bit big-endian at B10:B11 (ISO-TP 0x07:0x08). 2026-07-20: verified against VCU vehicle speed across 179 driving samples — rpm/speed ratio = 62.8 (median), matching the physical single-speed reduction (gear 7.412 × 205/55R16 tyre ≈ 61.8 rpm per km/h). Reads 0 at park (live READY capture) and peaks ~6650 at 107 km/h; slightly negative during regen/rock-back. Old expr ((S7<<8)|B6) read B6/B7 (0xFF 0xFF) = -1 — wrong bytes.

LDC_HV_INPUT_V.notes: HV battery (pack) voltage at the LDC — the always-present DC-link. 2026-07-20: reads 385.7V in READY and 386.9V charging, matching BMS BATTERY_VOLTAGE (385.6V) — present in BOTH states, unlike the OBC charge-side senses ([B10:B11], [B12:B13]) which idle to ~0-6V in READY. (Earlier guesses [B12:B13]/100 and B23*2 were wrong: [B12:B13] is OBC-only; B23*2≈372-378V doesn't track pack.) ISO-TP bytes 0x26-0x27 — only in the full 48-byte response. Cross-check at one SOC (~85%) only.

LDC_OUTPUT_V.notes: LDC 12V system output voltage. 14.52V charging / 14.31V READY — correct for 12V system. ISO-TP bytes 20-21. Load-test confirmed 2026-07-22: sagged 14.5→13.6→14.5V as a rear-defroster (~15-20A) load was switched ON→OFF, i.e. the real 12V rail.

LDC_TEMP.notes: LDC/converter temperature. 2026-07-20: corrected from B21-40 (which varies too much → not a temp). B19-100 = 21°C at READY (≈18°C ambient) and rises smoothly 28→65°C over a 3h AC charge (10:45→13:50) — textbook thermal behaviour; live 10A-AC charge read 27°C. Matches Soul LDC "-100" offset. ISO-TP byte 0x0f.

OBC_CHARGE_V.notes: OBC charge voltage into battery. ~370V during AC charging, ~6V idle (READY). ISO-TP bytes 7-8.

OBC_OUTPUT_V.notes: OBC DC output voltage (charge-side). ~353-384V during AC charging, but only ~3.8V in READY (OBC idle) — which is why it is NOT the LDC HV input (see LDC_HV_INPUT_V = B23*2). Was previously mislabelled LDC_HV_INPUT_V. ISO-TP bytes 9-10.

OBC_DC_A.notes: OBC DC output current during charging. ~2.85A (close to BMS charging current ~2.6A), 0A idle. ISO-TP bytes 13-14.

OBC_PILOT_DUTY.notes: J1772 control-pilot duty %. Verified 2026-07-27 EVSE step: 16.5/21.5/26.5% at 10/13/16A pilot (J1772 amps/0.6 = 16.7/21.7/26.7%). REPLACES the old B47/3, which was a noisy instantaneous pilot ADC sample (read ~28-40% regardless of the real duty). [B35:B36] is the clean filtered value; ISO-TP 0x1D-0x1E.

OBC_PILOT_AMPS.notes: EVSE-advertised max AC current (the negotiated pilot setpoint) = pilot-duty x 0.6. Verified 2026-07-27 EVSE step: 9.9/12.9/15.9A at 10/13/16A pilot. The car's ACTUAL draw is AC_INPUT_A (~0.6A less). REPLACES the old B47/5 (noisy instantaneous). Same source bytes as OBC_PILOT_DUTY (ISO-TP 0x1D-0x1E).

OBC_DC_POWER.notes: OBC DC output power to the HV bus = OBC_CHARGE_V * OBC_DC_A ([B10:B11]/100 * [B17:B18]/100 / 1000). Steady 3.30-3.36 kW across the 2026-07-26 16A AC charge, 0 when idle. Energy balance: OBC DC out 3.33kW = BMS BATTERY_POWER 3.10kW (into pack) + ~0.15kW LDC 12V load (14.5V*~10A); AC input measured 3.44-3.56kW => ~95% AC/DC charger efficiency. Both input params verified, product matches the external wattmeter.

AC_INPUT_A.notes: Measured AC input current (actual grid draw). Verified 2026-07-27 EVSE pilot step 10/13/16A -> 9.3/12.4/15.4A: tracks the pilot ~0.6A below the advertised limit and matches the power balance V_dc*I_dc/eff/V_ac. Low byte B34 is the ex-'constant 250 (0xFA)' from the steady 16A charge — it only varied once the current stepped. ISO-TP 0x1B-0x1C.

OBC_CHARGE_STATE.notes: Charge-session state at B20. Raw byte takes EXACTLY 3 values across the whole corpus (0/2/3, confirmed via raw-byte stats bypassing the enum - no undiscovered 4th value exists). 0->3->2 with the control-pilot: 0 = not connected (pilot 0%, this is also the value seen the entire time while driving/unplugged - relabelled from 'connected, EVSE idle' which was misleading), 3 = connected-standby (pilot 100%, not charging), 2 = active charge session (pilot 26.5% typical on AC, OBC_DC_A>0). Verified via pilot+current match on the 2026-08-02 AC charge, and a steady live 3 in ACC2 (plugged, 1h+ post-charge, not charging). 2026-08-08: BOTH of today's CCS DC-fast-charge sessions show the IDENTICAL 0->3->2 transition (DCFC-1 11:41:43->11:41:56; DCFC-2 16:31:45->16:32:01) even though OBC_DC_A/OBC_DC_POWER stay flat at 0 throughout (OBC's own AC path is bypassed during DC fast-charge, confirmed separately). So state=2 does NOT mean 'OBC's own AC relay is carrying current' in the DC case - it reflects a vehicle-level/CCS-session-active status that OBC also reports, not exclusively its own hardware state. Label kept generic ('active charge session') rather than OBC-specific to reflect this.

Unknown-746.description: Unknown ECU — KWP2000 only, no OBC evidence

VCU_VEHICLE_SPEED.notes: Speed. 16-bit MPH (low byte B19 unsigned, high byte S20), *1.609344/100 → km/h. r=0.999 vs ESC 22C101 REAL_SPEED_KMH (124 joined points, 2026-07-22 drive, 0-105.7 km/h). Finer than B20 alone (high byte, r=0.998). Do NOT use B21 as low byte (separate signal). Car reports MPH internally (cf. AAF 2181 B12).

GEAR.notes: Transmission range (PRND) as one readable value. RENAMED from DEBUG_DRIVE_MODE_FLAGS 2026-08-06: this profile uses 'drive mode' for Eco/Normal/Sport, so the old name misdescribed it — B10 is the gear/shifter position. Across 6365 captures B10 takes exactly 5 values: 0x21 park (n=5982), 0x28 drive (n=317), 0x22 reverse (n=54), 0x24 neutral (n=3), 0x01 park with bit5 clear (n=9). Bits 0-3 are one-hot P/R/N/D (see GEAR_P/R/N/D); bit5 is GEAR_SIGNAL_VALID; bits 4,6,7 are constant 0 in all captured data. Value 0x01 is park while the gear signal reads invalid, seen only during VCU power-mode transitions.

GEAR_P.notes: Gear = Park. One-hot bit of the GEAR byte (B10). n=5991 across 6365 captures. RENAMED from DRIVE_MODE_P 2026-08-06 (this profile uses 'drive mode' for Eco/Normal/Sport; B10 is the transmission range). Mirrored into B26:5 — see GEAR_P_MIRROR_B26_5.

GEAR_R.notes: Gear = Reverse. One-hot bit of the GEAR byte (B10). n=54, all on 2026-07-19 and 2026-07-26. RENAMED from DRIVE_MODE_R 2026-08-06. Cross-confirmed by ESC GEAR_SELECTOR=2 over the 2026-07-26 driveway reversing segments.

GEAR_N.notes: Gear = Neutral. One-hot bit of the GEAR byte (B10). Only n=3, all at 2026-07-19 17:42 — the sole Neutral observation in the corpus, and ESC 22C101 was not co-polled that day, so ESC GEAR_SELECTOR=3 is still unconfirmed. RENAMED from DRIVE_MODE_N 2026-08-06.

GEAR_D.notes: Gear = Drive. One-hot bit of the GEAR byte (B10). n=317 across 6365 captures. RENAMED from DRIVE_MODE_D 2026-08-06. NOTE: B26:3 is NOT this signal — it is not-Park (set in R and N too); see GEAR_PARK_INV.

VEHICLE_STATE_NOT_BRAKING.notes: Brake released (the complement switch of VEHICLE_STATE_BRAKE_LAMP, B11:0). 2026-08-06: B11 bits 0/1 are a REDUNDANT SWITCH PAIR, not complements — across 6365 captures both read 0 in 4178 rows (almost all VCU_POWER_STATE=7 charge standby) and both read 1 in 5. So 0 does NOT mean 'braking': it also means the brake signal is not available, which is the usual case whenever the drive path is down. Only trust this bit while drive-ready (VCU_POWER_STATE=4).

DEBUG_GEAR_STATE_FLAGS.notes: Park / not-Park state, mirrored out of the gear byte. CORRECTED 2026-08-06: across 6365 captures B26 takes only two values — 0x20 (Park) and 0x08 (Reverse, Neutral OR Drive). The earlier note read 0x08 as 'Drive' and cited r=+0.984 vs the drive bit over 773 captures; with R and N now sampled (54 and 3) that is disproven — 0x08 is simply not-Park. Bit3 and bit5 are exact complements and both mirror GEAR (B10), so B26 carries no information B10 does not; its two bit params are disabled as mirrors. Bits 0,1,2,4,6,7 are constant 0 in all captured data.

VCU_INVERTER_ENABLED.notes: Inverter/HV-power-active flag. B23 = 0x34 (52) when EV_READY/driving, 0x00 when charging/sleep (r=+0.997 vs VEHICLE_STATE_EV_READY across 776 captures). 0x34 = bit2|bit4|bit5 set; bit2 chosen as the boolean. Redundant with VEHICLE_STATE_EV_READY (B11:3) but sourced from a different byte — useful as a cross-check. Raw byte B23 itself only ever 0 or 52.

VCU_POWER_STATE.notes: VCU/EPCU power-mode state machine (B25). 4=drive_ready (EV READY, inverter/drive path enabled), 7=charge_standby (drive path down — AC charging OR key-off standby), 6=transition (caught at charge termination 2026-07-27, HV spinning down). r=-1.000 vs VEHICLE_STATE_EV_READY across the fleet of captures. Independent of the B11 state bitfield. 2026-08-06: value 1 (n=21) was undeclared by this enum — it occurs only in the 2026-07-30 power-cycle window, bracketed by GEAR_SIGNAL_VALID (B10:5) dropping, with B23=0x34 (inverter still enabled) throughout. Labelled unknown_1 rather than guessed: the value is established, its meaning is not. A --keep-all power cycle should resolve it.

VCU_INVERTER_INPUT_VOLTAGE.notes: HV DC-link (= battery pack) voltage. 2026-07-20: identified via Kia Soul EV VMCU reference (0x7E2, "Inverter Input Voltage = f*2"). Old guess B10*2 gave ~2V (B10=0x01, wrong). 2026-08-08: cross-validated against OBC:2101:LDC_HV_INPUT_V across the whole corpus (r=0.998, n=5689, fit slope 0.5024 matches B17*2 almost exactly) using today's DCFC-2 high-voltage swing as a wide-range test signal. B17*2 reads 364–382V in ready/driving across 1317 captures (range 28–412V over all states), matching BMS pack voltage (~369V) and LDC HV input (~353V) — the inverter DC-link is the pack. Cross-validated while charging (2026-07-20, SOC 94%): B17*2 = 396V vs BMS pack 396.4V — spot on. NOTE: Soul's letter positions do NOT transfer directly (its f = our B17, its e = our B18); the Ioniq VCU 2102 field order differs from the Soul VMCU.

VCU_AUX_BATTERY_VOLTAGE.notes: 12V bus voltage at B14 (empirical scale 0.0974, ~=B14/10.27). Found by absolute-value anchoring: B14 hits ~14.5V charging and ~12.2V in ACC2 with one scale, where the old B18/10 could not (B18 tracked the bus inversely). Verified: B14*0.0974 matches the OBC LDC_OUTPUT_V / BMS AUX / BCM 12V consensus to mean|d|=0.032V across the full 12.4-15.0V range (n=696), incl. the live ACC2 point. Scale is empirical (+/-0.03V); reads at VCU's local node. Was mis-defined as B18/10.

VCU_HV_MAIN_RELAY_ON.notes: HV main-relay/DC-link-present flag at B10 (ISO-TP 0x07); neighbours B9/B11 constant. 1 while HV contactors closed (READY+charging, bus ~360V), 0 when open. Verified: flipped 1->0 at 11:18:39 as LDC_HV_INPUT collapsed 206->6.7V, and live in ACC2 read 0 with bus at 6.3V. Mirrors BMS_MAIN_RELAY and BMS_HV_RELAY_FLAG (B62).
